name: Vision2Code
intro: Vision2Code 是 BenchCAD 的图像到代码子任务，要求模型依据四个标准正投影视图生成可执行的CadQuery程序，并评估几何重建、细节保真、关键CAD操作恢复和代码可执行性。
metric: 体素IoU；Chamfer距离、Hausdorff距离、Feature-F1、关键操作召回率和执行率
task_type: 空间推理, CAD代码生成
scale: 17,900个CAD部件，覆盖106个工业零件族；每项含4个标准正投影视图
intro_en: Vision2Code is BenchCAD's image-to-code task, requiring models to generate executable CadQuery programs from four canonical orthographic views and evaluating geometry reconstruction, detail fidelity, essential CAD-operation recovery, and executability.
scale_en: 17,900 CAD parts across 106 industrial families; four canonical orthographic views per item
metric_en: Voxel IoU; Chamfer distance, Hausdorff distance, Feature-F1, essential-operation recall, and execution rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Pinned to arXiv:2605.10865 (BenchCAD), Sections 3.1-3.2 (pp.4-5) and Section 4.3 (p.6), specifically the VISION2CODE subtask. Do not conflate it with the independent paper arXiv:2605.11307. The paper names the composite metric components but does not publish a complete explicit VISION2CODE total-score formula.. The benchmark represented by the site entry is BenchCAD VISION2CODE. Experts define 106 industrial part families and a typed generation stack (schema, sampler, validator, builder) that emits easy/medium/hard parameters and CadQuery programs. Programs that fail compilation, exceed 30 seconds, have volume at or below 10⁻⁶ mm³, or contain an inverted transform with negative determinant are quarantined; experts visually sign off the rest, producing 17,900 items. Evaluation reconstructs CadQuery from four canonical orthographic views and reports voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature-F1, essential-operation recall, and execution rate. The paper does not expose the full composite formula, so none is invented.
